_comment: DFTB: Slater-Koster tables read from a directory of .skf files, one per ordered species pair -- C-C.skf, C-H.skf, H-C.skf and so on. data/skf holds a small synthetic C-C.skf with smooth decaying integrals, so this runs with no downloads; for real work point skf_dir at a released set (mio-1-1, 3ob, ...) and expect different numbers.

model._comment: The basis is declared, not inferred: a .skf tabulates all ten channels up to d whether or not the parameterization uses them, and DFTB+ likewise takes the basis from its own input. DFTB data always carries both H and S, so the model is non-orthogonal -- which is why no velocity- or position-dependent task appears below.

run._comment: A Gamma-centred 2x2x2 mesh. Observables return one row per k-point, in the order the mesh generates them.
